[!isolates] skip
# A generic aggregate return converts a shape address to the concrete type.
# Ownership probes must pass its address using the pointer ABI.
go build -gcflags=all=-d=isolateheap=2 -o move.exe .
exec ./move.exe

-- go.mod --
module example.com/generic-move
go 1.26
-- main.go --
package main

type record struct {
 Name, Description string
 Kind byte
 Unit, Number string
}
type cache[T any] struct{}

//go:noinline
func (*cache[T]) Lookup(fallback func() T) T {return fallback()}

//go:noinline
func lookup(id record) record {
 var c cache[record]
 return c.Lookup(func() record {return id})
}

func main() {
 want:=record{Name:"metric",Description:"copied",Kind:3,Unit:"seconds",Number:"int64"}
 got:=lookup(want)
 if got!=want {panic("generic aggregate move changed value")}
}
